newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank bond rate drops to 2.6015 pct.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank bond rate drops to 2.6015 pct.

text.p: Brazil's benchmark overnight rate dropped to 2.6015 percent a month, from 2.617 percent last week, at today's 7.251 billion reais sale of 56-day Central Bank Bonds (BBC), dealers said.
The result of the auction was slightly higher than the market expectations and indicated a lower demand for the bonds, they added.
The 56-day bonds will mature on November 6. Today's auction is expected to add 249 million reais to the banking system, with 7.5 billion reais in old bonds coming due Wednesday.
